    • storeName

      public CausalConsumers.Builder<K,V> storeName(String storeName)
      Sets the state-store namespace (default "parsley"). The frontier store is storeName + "-frontier" and the buffer store storeName + "-buffer"; these name the backing changelog topics, so keep storeName stable across restarts.
      Parameters:
      storeName - the state-store namespace
      Returns:
      this builder

    • topicAdmin

      public CausalConsumers.Builder<K,V> topicAdmin(io.parsley.ParsleyTopicAdmin topicAdmin)
      Overrides the ParsleyTopicAdmin used for outbox setup (default: a live Kafka Admin created from bootstrap.servers). Supply a MockAdminClient in tests to avoid a real broker dependency or to force deterministic name-derived UUIDs so that CausalPosition.deriveUuid(String) produces the same UUID the consumer uses for those topics, keeping test UUIDs consistent.
      Parameters:
      topicAdmin - the ParsleyTopicAdmin to use; closed automatically after outbox setup
      Returns:
      this builder

    • deadLetterSink

      public CausalConsumers.Builder<K,V> deadLetterSink(Consumer<org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.ConsumerRecord<K,V>> deadLetterSink)
      Sets the sink that receives records evicted under a dead-letter policy, delivered as typed ConsumerRecords — deserialized with the same key/value serdes as CausalConsumer.poll(Duration), at the record's original source topic/partition/offset, and carrying the parsley-dlq-* headers described in CausalViolation. Required for a dead-letter policy and illegal for any other.

      Runs on the internal Kafka Streams thread, so the sink must be thread-safe — the same caveat as onViolation.

      Parameters:
      deadLetterSink - the dead-letter sink
      Returns:
      this builder

    • build

      public CausalConsumer<K,V> build()
      Builds and starts the CausalConsumer.
      Returns:
      a new, running CausalConsumer
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if policy is a dead-letter policy and no sink was set via deadLetterSink, or a sink was set but policy is not a dead-letter policy
